description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the UserAPI class, specifically testing various CRUD operations such as getAll, getOne, create, and update for the User API in the OrangeHRM project's admin API module.

classes.name: UserAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the UserAPI REST endpoints, covering CRUD operations and setup of test fixtures and mock services.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the environment before each test, specifically truncating the OpenIdProvider table.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all user records via the getAll API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single user record via the getOne API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new user record via the create API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing the create endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing user record via the update API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides data sets for testing the update endpoint.

methods.name: enableSocialMediaAuthPreHook
methods.description: Enables social media authentication by setting the status of an OpenIdProvider entity to active.
